newsitem.title: USA: USAir Q3 int'l traffic up on Europe service.
newsitem.headline: USAir Q3 int'l traffic up on Europe service.

text.p: USAir Group Inc said on Monday that its total traffic was up 6.3 percent in the third quarter on a capacity increase of 1.3 percent.
The carrier reported third quarter earnings of $0.69 per share, well above the First Call estimate of $0.49 a share.
The carrier said third quarter international traffic was up 56.6 percent on a capacity increase of 47.3 percent, reflecting new service between Philadelphia and Munich, Rome and Madrid.
System load factor for the quarter was 69.8 percent, up 3.3 percentage points over the preceeding year.
